races.name: CopyBet Supporting UK Racing Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Petty Cash
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 46 days off with Henry Daly's yard ticking over steadily, but needs strong pace to maximize closing kick

runners_data.name: Maximum Offers
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in career-best form with Gavin Sheehan aboard, Jamie Snowden stable hitting 30% strike rate over past 14 days

runners_data.name: Mahler Moon
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with excellent recent record including two wins, Fergal O'Brien's 16% strike rate slightly below par but horse's form speaks volumes

runners_data.name: Smurfette
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with solid recent placed efforts, T Ellis yard running at 40% strike rate but needs leaders to come back to her

runners_data.name: The Gypsy Davey
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose poor recent form masks ability to control race tempo, amateur rider's 7lb claim offsets experience concerns

runners_data.name: Edgewell
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying just 148lbs after recent wins, but Nick Scholfield's 0/7 record over past fortnight raises trainer form concerns

races.paceDynamic: The Gypsy Davey will lead from flag to finish with Maximum Offers and Mahler Moon tracking in prominent positions behind. With only one confirmed front runner in a small field of 6, The Gypsy Davey can dictate a steady tempo over this staying trip without pressure. The three hold-up horses (Petty Cash, Smurfette, Edgewell) will need the prominent runners to fold late to get into contention. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close enough to strike when the leader tires.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey sets manageable fractions and Maximum Offers/Mahler Moon track within striking distance.
scenarios.body: The leaders maintain energy reserves for the business end while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. Prominent positioning proves crucial when the race develops into a sprint from 3 furlongs out.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey finds another gear when challenged and maintains stamina reserves.
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old's front-running style suits the lack of early pace pressure, allowing him to control throughout. Despite recent poor form, class tells when given an uncontested lead in this grade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast chasing The Gypsy Davey in the middle sections.
scenarios.body: Petty Cash or Smurfette benefit from a strong early gallop that sets up their closing kick. Hold-up specialists capitalize when the pace-setters weaken approaching the final fence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightweight Edgewell Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Edgewell's 18lb weight advantage allows him to close powerfully despite his hold-up style.
scenarios.body: The bottom-weight gets a perfect tow into the race and his recent winning form carries him past tiring rivals. Nick Scholfield's yard form remains concerning but the horse's individual merit shines through.

watchPoints.text: The Gypsy Davey setting excessive early fractions could compromise his stamina reserves and set up back runners
Maximum Offers and Mahler Moon getting too close to each other in prominent positions, creating tactical complications for both
Edgewell's ability to overcome trainer form concerns and get competitive from his hold-up position despite the 18lb weight advantage
Petty Cash needing the race to develop into a strong gallop to showcase his finishing kick after 46 days absence
Amateur rider Mr B T Stone's handling of The Gypsy Davey's front-running tactics under race pressure

runners_data.name: Haderach
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest official rating but 164 days off and pattern of fading suggests the layoff may not help his stamina

runners_data.name: Noble Don
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should get ideal position tracking Whatcombe but trainer's 0/5 strike rate in last 14 days is concerning

runners_data.name: Machete Beach
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse for in-form Snowden team returning from long break but proven on good ground with solid recent hurdles record

runners_data.name: Backer Bilk
runners_data.note: Young hold-up horse with 7lb claim who has been running consistently over shorter trips but faces tactical disadvantage

runners_data.name: Delta Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 382-day absence which makes any assessment extremely difficult despite decent official rating

runners_data.name: The Craftymaster
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from Carroll's yard returning after 18 days with solid hurdles record but needs pace to collapse

runners_data.name: Alex The Great
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with lowest rating who fades in finishes and faces both tactical and class disadvantage

runners_data.name: Whatcombe
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should lead unopposed but has pattern of fading which 4lb claim may not be enough to overcome

races.paceDynamic: Whatcombe looks the only natural front-runner in this field, with Noble Don the sole prominent runner likely to track him early. This sets up a sustainable pace scenario where Whatcombe can dictate terms without early pressure, potentially lasting longer than his usual fading pattern suggests. The bulk of the field - Haderach, Machete Beach, Backer Bilk, Delta Legend, The Craftymaster and Alex The Great - are all hold-up horses who will need the pace to collapse. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters and prominent racers, as the lack of pace pressure should allow them to control the tempo and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still getting organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Whatcombe Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe maintains a steady gallop without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The lone leader can dictate a comfortable tempo and have enough left to resist the late charge from the hold-up horses. Noble Don's prominent position gives him first run at the leader when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe's stamina gives out in the final half-mile as his form suggests
scenarios.body: The slow early pace leaves plenty of runners with chances as they swing for home together. The classiest hold-up horses with the best recent form can capitalize on the scramble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Noble Don Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Don tracks Whatcombe patiently then pounces at the perfect moment
scenarios.body: Burke's mount can use his prominent position to strike when Whatcombe begins to tire but before the back-markers arrive. His recent running suggests he's capable of better than his last few efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up Strike
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses produces an exceptional turn of foot despite the tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace actually suits a horse who can produce a devastating late burst. Haderach's class rating suggests he could be capable of this despite his layoff.

watchPoints.text: Whatcombe's jumping under pressure - if he makes mistakes when the field closes on him his chance disappears quickly
Noble Don's early positioning - if he gets further back than expected he loses his key tactical advantage
The Craftymaster's readiness after 18 days off - Carroll's horses sometimes need their comeback runs
How quickly the hold-up horses begin their moves - early moves suggest they're traveling well despite tactical disadvantage
Machete Beach's jumping rhythm after 359 days off - any rustiness over hurdles will be costly in a tight finish

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Earth King
runners_data.note: Recent Fontwell winner who handles good ground well and should settle handily behind Queens Venture to strike late

runners_data.name: I Spy A Diva
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 124 days off but trainer Kim Bailey excels with returning horses at big prices

runners_data.name: The Long Walk
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent type who can adapt if pace scenario changes but trainer Jonjo O'Neill struggling with just 0/17 in last fortnight

runners_data.name: Queens Venture
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning after 150 days but should get uncontested lead to dictate ideal fractions for her stamina

runners_data.name: Musique De Fee
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent form including close second 11 days ago, wears cheekpieces and needs strong pace

runners_data.name: Double Click
runners_data.note: Patient type who won at Fontwell 29 days ago and handles this ground, but 5lb claimer Isabelle Ryder needs tactical race

runners_data.name: Chavez
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse returning after 67 days with poor recent form and needs everything to fall right from the rear

races.paceDynamic: Queens Venture will lead from the start with no other natural front runners in this field, allowing her to dictate terms at a steady gallop over this extended trip. The prominent runners Earth King, I Spy A Diva and The Long Walk will track her in second gear, while the hold-up horses Musique De Fee, Double Click and Chavez will settle towards the rear. With Queens Venture able to bowl along uncontested, she can save energy for the finish, but the real beneficiaries will be those who can track her rhythm and pounce late. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers who can sit handy and strike, rather than hold-up horses who may find themselves too far back when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Venture gets an easy lead and maintains her jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: Her 150-day break becomes irrelevant as she controls every call, with the patient Bryan Carver able to quicken off steady fractions. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Earth King or I Spy A Diva sit perfectly behind Queens Venture and time their challenge
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigners use their class edge to reel in the leader, with Earth King's recent Fontwell win showing he retains his appetite. Queens Venture's long absence tells in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes searching in the middle stages with prominent horses pressing
scenarios.body: This creates the perfect setup for Musique De Fee or Double Click to unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace. The early leaders compound and fade, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Venture stops suddenly or falls, leaving no clear leader
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with prominent horses reluctant to take over, creating a muddling tempo. This suits The Long Walk who can adapt his style and pick up the pieces late.

watchPoints.text: Queens Venture's jumping early on - if she makes mistakes the whole pace complexion changes with no other natural leader
Earth King's settling - he needs to drop the bridle behind Queens Venture rather than getting keen and pressing the pace
I Spy A Diva's fitness first time back after 124 days - any signs of greenness or rust could derail her chance tracking the leader
The ground conditions - any further deterioration from good would significantly impact the hold-up horses' chances
Musique De Fee's position turning in - she must be within striking distance with her finishing kick to be competitive

races.paceDynamic: American Sniper will control this race from the front as the only confirmed leader, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Pike Road, Mount Anglesby, Cluain Chormaic, and Oakley will form a prominent group tracking the leader, creating a steady but not overly demanding early tempo. The lack of pace pressure means American Sniper can dictate terms and potentially kick clear turning for home. This tactical setup strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: American Sniper Controls
scenarios.trigger: If American Sniper gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader exploits the lack of early pace pressure to build an unassailable advantage in the straight. His class and tactical position prove decisive as the prominent runners struggle to close the gap.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the tracking quartet stays close enough to challenge American Sniper in the straight
scenarios.body: Mount Anglesby and Pike Road use their prominent styles to launch telling challenges, with Mount Anglesby's recent form and Pike Road's trainer record proving crucial. The leaders duel allows one of these to prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong and the leaders weaken significantly
scenarios.body: Donnie Azoff produces a trademark late surge from his hold-up position to catch tired leaders. His class advantage and fresh legs from the long break prove telling.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If American Sniper goes too slow and gets swamped by everything in the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace becomes a crawl, allowing every horse to stay in contention until a sprint finish. Superior class rather than position decides the outcome.

watchPoints.text: American Sniper getting first run on the field turning for home - if unopposed early, he could build a decisive advantage
Pike Road and Mount Anglesby tracking close enough to launch challenges - their prominent styles suit if they can position well
Donnie Azoff's jumping after 179 days off - any early mistakes would compromise his hold-up style severely
The pace becoming a crawl early - if American Sniper goes too slow, it negates his tactical advantage
Inexperienced jockeys on Donnie Azoff and Individualiste making crucial tactical decisions at key moments

races.name: Green Dragon Hotel Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Southey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should track Ettore nicely but hasn't won for 123 days and may lack the finishing kick to capitalize on good positioning.

runners_data.name: American Empire
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest RPR (105) and recent winning form, perfectly suited to pick up the pieces from the back if pace scenario unfolds.

runners_data.name: Tao Enki
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type with decent recent form in similar conditions, headgear applied suggests connections expect improvement from 58-day break.

runners_data.name: Not So Sobers
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 179-day layoff on the flat, the headgear and long break create questions despite his proven ability.

runners_data.name: Ettore
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter from the Henderson yard but low TopSpeed (44) suggests he may struggle to dominate throughout, vulnerable late.

runners_data.name: Triple Haych
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying bottom weight but form figures show tendency to fade in finishes, making him unreliable even if pace suits.

races.paceDynamic: Ettore will lead from the front with only Southey likely to track him early, creating a sustainable rhythm without serious pressure through the first mile. The four hold-up horses (American Empire, Tao Enki, Not So Sobers, Triple Haych) will settle at the back, relying on Ettore to provide a solid gallop to aim at. With such a small field and limited early pace pressure, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to time their challenges from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks against what should be a modest early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ettore sets only a steady pace and the hold-up quartet get perfect positioning
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the closers to conserve energy and unleash devastating finishes, with Ettore and Southey vulnerable to being swamped late. American Empire and Tao Enki are best positioned to capitalize with their strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Ettore maintains a stronger gallop than expected and Southey tracks him perfectly
scenarios.body: The early leaders get first run on the field and hold off late challenges through superior positioning and rhythm. Southey's prominent style pays dividends as he can quicken off Ettore's pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Mess Benefits One
scenarios.trigger: If the small field creates a stop-start tactical affair with no clear tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning trumps stamina, suiting whichever horse gets the clearest run at the right moment. American Empire's class could prove decisive in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Ettore goes too slow early and creates a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: All six horses arrive together in the final furlong creating chaos, where experience and finishing speed matter most. The race becomes a lottery but American Empire's higher OR gives him the edge.

watchPoints.text: Triple Haych has a pattern of fading in the finish - if he's still in contention turning for home, expect him to weaken quickly
Ettore's early pace-setting will be crucial - if he goes too slow early, it sets up a cavalry charge finish that could catch out punters
American Empire's positioning through the race will be key given his hold-up style - needs Ettore to provide enough gallop to aim at
Not So Sobers returning from nearly six months off the track - watch for any signs of ring-rustiness or fitness concerns
Southey needs to be handy to Ettore throughout to have any chance - if he gets detached early his race is over

races.name: Wye Valley Skips Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Away For The Night
runners_data.note: Strong prominent runner with solid recent form but faces significant early traffic in congested tactical position behind three confirmed leaders.

runners_data.name: Kally Des Bruyeres
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly positioned to benefit from expected strong gallop, wearing tongue-tie and boasts excellent course form with 2W2P record.

runners_data.name: Fox Wallace
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner carrying just 146lbs but has been pulling hard in recent starts and may not settle in expected pace battle.

runners_data.name: O'Grady's Hill
runners_data.note: Another guaranteed leader but recent form shows inconsistency and faces stronger pace rivals in Fox Wallace and Prairie Queen.

runners_data.name: Daany
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with class but 9-year-old legs face tough test in anticipated traffic jam behind the leading trio.

runners_data.name: Kill The Groove
runners_data.note: Solid prominent type but trainer form concerning at 0/4 in past 14 days and lacks the tactical pace for this likely scenario.

runners_data.name: Prairie Queen
runners_data.note: Most consistent front-runner of the three leaders with recent good form and lightest weight of 145lbs in her favour.

runners_data.name: Danny's Friend
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 146-day break but Christian Williams stable in good form and horse won last time on good going.

runners_data.name: Mi Sueno
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who historically fades in finish faces worst possible scenario with expected sustained gallop testing stamina.

races.paceDynamic: Fox Wallace, Prairie Queen, and O'Grady's Hill will establish a relentless gallop from the outset, with all three confirmed front-runners unlikely to yield. Away For The Night, Daany, Kill The Groove, and Mi Sueno will create significant congestion in the prominent positions behind the leaders, likely bunching up approaching the final three fences. The sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over the final half-mile. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses like Kally Des Bruyeres and Danny's Friend who can avoid the early traffic and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Fox Wallace, Prairie Queen and O'Grady's Hill maintain their gallop without collapsing
scenarios.body: The relentless pace stretches the field and eliminates the prominent pack who cannot sustain the tempo. Hold-up horses sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong with superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Away For The Night or Daany can secure clean jumping through the congested middle phase
scenarios.body: One of the stronger prominent runners survives the traffic and has enough left to outlast the fading pace-setters. Their tactical position proves optimal between the suicidal leaders and too-far-back hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Survives Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Queen can dictate fractions and kick clear approaching the final fence
scenarios.body: The classiest front-runner uses tactical speed to avoid a war of attrition and maintains enough for the finish. Her recent consistent form and 145lb weight advantage prove decisive over pursuing rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast initially and come back to the field before halfway
scenarios.body: The pace battle burns out early leaving a messy tactical affair with no sustained gallop. Mid-division runners with tactical speed can position closer and prove strongest in a moderate finish.

watchPoints.text: Fox Wallace and O'Grady's Hill both tend to pull hard early and could set suicidal fractions that eliminate each other.
Away For The Night and Daany will likely meet significant traffic problems 2-3 out when four prominent runners hit the same piece of ground.
Kally Des Bruyeres needs the strong pace to materialize or his hold-up style becomes a liability in a slowly-run tactical affair.
Danny's Friend returning from 146-day layoff may need the run despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace scenario.
Mi Sueno's tendency to fade in the finish makes him vulnerable if the anticipated strong gallop stretches his stamina reserves.
